name: Carousel
summary: Horizontally paginated content scroller. Renders a slide track with snap-points; auto-advance is OFF by default (auto-advance is a WCAG 2.2.2 hazard unless explicitly opt-in with controls). Includes prev/next IconButtons, dot indicators, and optional progress. Distinct from Tabs (sibling views) and ProductGallery (image-zoom flavor).

items.description: Array of slide nodes. Each slide is a child element with content.

autoplay.description: Auto-advance interval in ms. OFF by default. When set, render a visible Pause control + pause on hover/focus per WCAG 2.2.2.

perView.description: Visible slides per view. > 1 for 'and-a-half' previews.

rules: Each slide: role='group' + aria-roledescription='slide' + aria-label='Slide N of M'.
Active slide is the only one fully visible; off-screen slides have aria-hidden='true'.
When autoplay is set, a visible Pause control is REQUIRED and the carousel pauses on hover + focus.
Honor prefers-reduced-motion: drop the slide transition; cut directly to the active slide.
Announcing slide changes via aria-live='polite' is debounced (don't fire every 100 ms during a drag).

do: Use dots indicator when items.length ≤ 6, fraction ('2 of 12') when > 6.
Always render prev/next controls — gesture-only carousels fail keyboard users.
perView=1 on mobile, 2-3 on tablet/desktop only if the content benefits from comparison.
Use snap='center' for Apple-flavor card carousels; 'start' for product-grid scrollers.
dont: Don't autoplay testimonials or hero banners without a Pause.
Don't loop a CTA carousel — the user must reach the end and make a decision.
Don't paint inactive dots in lime — only the active dot uses text.accent.
Don't put primary actions inside a non-active slide that can't be reached without scrolling.

changelog.note: Initial Carousel contract. Autoplay OFF default per WCAG 2.2.2. Four indicator modes.
